reviews.text: Super nice

Bad advice.
I was just passing through and bought a harness following the salesperson's advice. He tried it on my dog ​​and said it was okay, so I trusted him.
The result? When I got home, the harness was too big; it was hanging off my dog.
I don't live in Marseille, otherwise I would have gone back.
They simply pushed on me whatever size they had left over.
That's unprofessional.
Friendly and professional salespeople, always eager to help you :)
Are there any pit bulls or Rittwellers available? Please tell me the price if so.

Went there to get a Ruffwear harness for my dog and was really impressed by the huge selection of products for both dogs and cats. Both the human staff and the canine staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and genuinely helpful throughout. A great place for pet owners- you can easily find something your pet will love.

Amazing staff. We needed boots for our dog and they helped us choosing the best ones, gave us advice on how to use them in the calanques and even on which were the best to visit with our furry friend.

I highly recommend this store. The salesperson, whose name I don't know, helped me with my purchases for my picky Maine Coon, and gave me such good advice that I immediately followed all his suggestions as soon as I got home and finally managed to satisfy my cat.

The prices are more than reasonable for quality products.

Always perfect, great shop, the staff are exceptional, our super delivery driver is always very professional and lovely. I recommend this shop more than ever for our children, dogs, and cats. A shop not to be missed, and we always receive excellent advice at every level. Great selection of collars, leashes, and amazing toys ♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️
Great 👍 nothing to say, my dog ​​loves his kibble …
Great team, excellent selection, good follow-up, the location is fantastic and the staff genuinely love animals, but the prices... it's really very expensive...
Excellent products, a good selection, and a very professional welcome.
A great shop with excellent advice! Thank you!
Great shop for dogs 🐕 and cats 🐱. The staff are friendly and attentive to their customers, including those with large dogs like Beaucerons. Thank you! …

Excellent!

Great staff at the store, the best selection in Marseille.
Excellent sales staff! Lots of choices!
Be careful in the heat, it can scare people away if you try to put men on a leash

Fantastic welcome.
The dog is treated like royalty, and what's more, he can try on all the clothes he wants.
I highly recommend this store.
Always great advice!
Excellent, super friendly customer service. High-quality product.
A magical place for our puppies and kittens... the team is very friendly and offers excellent advice. Olaf and I adore them! Long live DSA 13!

My dog ​​is 11 years old today, and I've been a DSA member for 11 years. A huge thank you to our international friend Laurent, who has always given such good and valuable advice, and especially to our dear Ben, our incredible kibble delivery guy, who is so kind, caring, always punctual, and ready to help.

Thank you all! ❤️❤️❤️

A fantastic team, with excellent listening skills to provide the most suitable advice for our furry friends 🐶
A friendly, family atmosphere; each of our dogs and cats is treated like a VIP.
I highly recommend them. …
Competent, kind, good selection of products, our little Toffee loves it and so do we!

Great prices / Great staff / Great owner
Go there, good advice
A wide selection for our dogs, and the staff are always helpful. My dog ​​is always happy to come and see them. I recommend them.

Laurent and his team are always top-notch.
Affordable rates, kindness, professionalism, and a love for dogs and animals.
You're the best, Laurent, in all of France!
Thank you!
The Rhodesian Ridgeback Team
Amazing shop with so many choices! 😍😍😍😍 Thank you! …
They gave excellent advice and were really friendly.
My favorite store is a paradise for your pets. I highly recommend this place.

A superb shop to spoil our four-legged friends 🐾 clean and well-stocked with quality products. I went with my three little Pekingese and we were very warmly welcomed by Quentin, who always gave good advice and whose love for animals is evident. Thank you again! …
What a pleasure to discover a shop where the staff really know their stuff! The advice is relevant and personalized. From now on, my Billy will only eat your amazing kibble!
Excellent advice for our beloved dogs, very well received

The best place in Marseille for your four-legged friend. The staff is lovely and incredibly competent. The service is personalized, and every pet becomes a member of the store family. I highly recommend it!
A delight for our pets. Very friendly and professional team. They give great advice. Quality food products.
Warm welcome and excellent advice, thank you

Hello,

This is for animals: food, treats, chew toys, accessories like leashes, harnesses, etc., and enrichment toys. The staff are welcoming, friendly, attentive, and offer good advice. A very pleasant place (especially for our furry friends).

Thank you!

Have a lovely day!

Best regards,

Graziella
Very nice
A fantastic welcome in this paradise for dogs!
Always a warm welcome and great advice, the product selection is really good! We stop by every time we're in Marseille!

A superb shop for our dogs, run by helpful, friendly, and passionate people.

We'll definitely be back.

They also offer home delivery for dog food.
Go check it out!

Honestly, I was pleasantly surprised! The welcome was fabulous, the prices very competitive for excellent quality products, and above all, traceable because they're local! I couldn't have dreamed of anything better for my beloved little girl 💖 …
Very friendly and attentive team
Fantastic pet shop for dogs and cats. What sets them apart? The quality of their customer service – the team is friendly, smiling, and passionate about animals. Go there without hesitation!

A loyal customer for a few months now, buying kibble for our two little Spitz dogs,

I also found a rather expensive but high-quality carrier backpack there.

I wish there were a bit more choice in coats. Pleasant service and a loyalty card.
The team is lovely, attentive, and knowledgeable; it's a pleasure to be there! Lots of choices!

The go-to store for dogs and pets in Marseille. Quality products at prices as competitive as those in supermarkets, so let's support DSA 13! The whole team is lovely and offers excellent advice.
A huge selection of toys, equipment, and treats, with new items constantly being added. Well done for your passion and your great selection!
The magical world of our pets.
Excellent products, very pleasant team and very good advice
Got some great advice on sizing our dogs collar, really helpful  young man . Attentive service with a smile. Collar and toy went down a treat
A pleasant, safe, family-run shop with good advice. Great!

As longtime customers for cat, kitten, and dog food, we have always received a very warm welcome and, above all, excellent advice.

We had consulted a behaviorist for our dog, but in the end, Laurent, the owner, gave us better advice than the behaviorist!
You can tell they're not just salespeople, but people who love animals and their well-being! We recommend them without hesitation, and we even order for our friends and family who can't make it to Marseille to shop for themselves.
Friendly staff, great prices, perfect selection of treats and food.
We're thrilled!!! Excellent advice, took his time, no pressure to buy, very professional!!! Great vibes!!
